## 1. What CC0 covers

Only data that this repository **generates itself**, with a fixed seed, from code it owns.
That includes:

- tabular and text datasets produced by the generator functions named below;
- image, graph, time-series and reinforcement-learning environments constructed in code;
- the committed sample files `modules/M11-…/code/gen_samples.npz` and
  `modules/M13-…/code/data/rai_datasets.npz`, which are outputs of those generators;
- datasets regenerated by a student running the same script.

## 3. What CC0 does not cover

- **Real datasets.** UCI digits (via scikit-learn), Fashion-MNIST, Iris and anything else
  downloaded at runtime keep their upstream licences and are **not** relicensed here.
  None of them is committed to this repository.
- **Pretrained model weights.** `distilgpt2`, `gpt2`, `t5-small`/`flan-t5-small`,
  `distilbert-base-uncased` and `all-MiniLM-L6-v2` are downloaded at runtime under their
  own licences (see [THIRD-PARTY-ATTRIBUTIONS.md](THIRD-PARTY-ATTRIBUTIONS.md)).
- **Text quoted from third-party sources.** Only the synthetic documents authored for the
  course are CC0.
- **Student work.** Anything you produce using the datasets is yours; CC0 places no
  condition on your output.

## 4. Integrity notes

- The committed `.npz` files are **generated artifacts**, not primary sources. Regenerating
  them may change byte-level layout but not the documented statistics, because every
  generator is seeded.
- Synthetic data is labelled as synthetic wherever it is used. It must not be presented as
  evidence about real populations; the dataset cards state the intended use and limits.
- If you redistribute a modified dataset, do not imply it was produced by this course or
  that its statistics still hold.

## 5. Reporting a problem

If a dataset listed here is later found to contain third-party material, it will be removed
from the CC0 catalogue and documented as third party. Open an issue with the file and the
source; corrections take priority over convenience.
